name: wenzhi-plugins
description: Wenzhi Ding 的 ZCode 插件市场

plugins.name: humanize
plugins.description: 向中英文写作注入「说人话」要求：句子语法完整；因果直说不打比方、不自造压缩说法；外文名词按意思取最恰当译法、不写翻译腔；不用空洞大词；解释不省略理解所必需的中间步骤，简洁删冗余不删推理步骤；保证信息充分的前提下尽可能简洁。会话回复和起草的产出物都适用。

description_i18n.en: Injects plain-speech rules into Chinese and English writing: complete sentences; causation stated directly, without metaphors or coined compressions; foreign terms rendered by their most fitting meaning, not word-for-word; no hollow buzzwords; explanations keep every intermediate step the reader needs—concision cuts redundancy, not reasoning steps; as concise as possible while keeping the information sufficient. Applies to chat replies and drafted artifacts.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 向中英文写作注入「说人话」要求：句子语法完整；因果直说不打比方、不自造压缩说法；外文名词按意思取最恰当译法、不写翻译腔；不用空洞大词；解释不省略理解所必需的中间步骤，简洁删冗余不删推理步骤；保证信息充分的前提下尽可能简洁。会话回复和起草的产出物都适用。

plugins.name: model-providers
plugins.description: 模型厂商 provider 配置 registry：收录各家在 ZCode 中验证过的端点、kind 与 reasoning 档位，用 /providers-sync 同步到本机 config.json。

description_i18n.en: Provider config registry: verified endpoints, protocol kinds, and reasoning tiers per model vendor, synced into local config.json via /providers-sync.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 模型厂商 provider 配置 registry：收录各家在 ZCode 中验证过的端点、kind 与 reasoning 档位，用 /providers-sync 同步到本机 config.json。

plugins.name: skill-stats
plugins.description: 统计每个技能（skill）被触发的次数，并区分触发来源——用户输入 /技能名 触发，还是 agent 主动选择调用；用 /skill-stats 查看统计表。

description_i18n.en: Counts how often each skill is triggered and tells who triggered it — the user typing /skill-name, or the agent choosing it on its own; view the table with /skill-stats.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 统计每个技能（skill）被触发的次数，并区分触发来源——用户输入 /技能名 触发，还是 agent 主动选择调用；用 /skill-stats 查看统计表。
